//: Composite indexes for the queries in server/store.mjs.
Every entry below is required by a specific query; removing one turns that
query into a FAILED_PRECONDITION at runtime, not at build time.
Single-field indexes (at, nextAttemptAt, createdAt) are automatic in Firestore.
TTL policies are configured per field and cannot be expressed here — see
docs/SECURITY.md §7 for the three policies to enable.

indexes.//: audit.list({ adGroupId }) → where adGroupId == + orderBy at desc
audit.list({}) → orderBy at desc, plus the /api/audit ok=false filter
outbox.due() → where status == pending + nextAttemptAt <= now, orderBy nextAttemptAt
outbox.list({ status }) → where status == + orderBy createdAt desc
